# NUASA National Body

> National Union of Accountancy Students Association — National Body E-Library and Blog. Thousands of accounting resources, research papers, study guides, past questions, and articles for Nigerian students.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the NUASA National Body platform, featured resources, and latest posts.
- [E-Library](/library): Searchable digital library of accounting resources, research papers, study materials, and past questions across categories like Auditing, Taxation, and Public Sector Accounting.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles and insights from NUASA contributors on accounting, careers, and student life.
- [Chapters](/chapters): Directory of NUASA chapters at universities across Nigeria.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming and past NUASA conferences, workshops, and chapter activities.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Account sign-in for registered students.
- [Register](/register): Create a free NUASA student account.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](/terms)
